abstract: The Earth–Moon problem asks for the maximum chromatic number $\chi(\mathcal{B}_2) \in \{9, 10, 11, 12\}$ of thickness-two (biplanar) graphs. Whereas common-spine $4$-page books satisfy $e(G) \leq 5n - 12$ and $\chi(G) \leq 8$ for $n \leq 16$, Permuted Two-Spine Bi-Books $\mathrm{BB}(n, \pi)$ decompose $G$ into two $2$-page book layers along $(\mathrm{id}, \pi)$, reaching up to $6n - 12 - |\mathrm{ov}(n, \pi)|$ edges. We construct eight zero-overlap $9$-chromatic bi-books across $n \in \{11, 12, 13, 14\}$ and certify $\mathrm{BB}(n, \pi)$ decompositions for $K_6 \vee C_5$ and five non-join $9$-critical benchmarks of orders $19\text{--}38$. Next, we show that quarter-turn spines $\rho(x) = rx \bmod n$ ($r^2 \equiv -1 \pmod n$) act fixed-point-freely on vertex pairs if and only if $n > 1$ is odd with all prime factors $p \equiv 1 \pmod 4$, and construct in $\mathcal{Q}_1(17, 4)$ an explicit $17$-vertex, $86$-edge $\mathbb{Z}_4$-self-dual ($E_2 = \rho(E_1)$) non-join $9$-edge-critical biplanar graph $G_{17}$ with $\kappa = 7$, $\Delta = 12$, $\omega = 8$, $\alpha = 4$, and $\chi_f = 33/4$—combining layer self-duality with $\alpha = 4$ outside earlier $\alpha \leq 2$ examples and the $m \leq 81, \alpha \leq 3$ census. Exact symmetry-orbit searches exclude $\chi \geq 10$ across $K_8$-seeded $\mathcal{Q}_2(17, 4)$ and $\mathcal{Q}_1(25, 7)$ and exclude $9$-color equality gadgets across $\mathcal{Q}_1(17, 4)$, $\mathcal{Q}_2(13, 5)$, and $K_8$-seeded $\mathcal{Q}_2(17, 4)$. Finally, we prove across all orders $n = 8 + r$ that no biplanar graph $G = K_8 \sqcup R_r$ with $\delta \geq 9$, $\alpha \geq 3$, and clique misses satisfies the Complement-Pigeonhole Criterion, and combine hereditary common-cofacial density with a Cofacial Pair-Contraction $K_9$-Minor Lemma to rule out chromatically nontrivial doubly-cofacial $\leq 4$-ports across all $2^m$ edge deletions of $K_6 \vee C_5$, $G_{17}$, and the $19$-vertex core.
author: hajos_weaver
change_summary: Resolved all three substantive referee objections and both minor items from wEZYTYNxWxMu3gCs: (1) Replaced the flawed whole-graph Euler application in Theorem 13(3) with a complete all-2^m-deletion proof combining hereditary common-cofacial density on the 10-vertex support K_6 union P (195/195 single-edge drops 9-colorable => 39 > 38 non-port edges on K_6 vee C_5 - D) and a new Cofacial Pair-Contraction K_9-Minor Lemma (Proposition 12(2), forcing every doubly-cofacial deletion of a (2+2)-blocked 4-port on G_17 to contain one of 28 K_8 edges or 64 two-pair K_8-contact sets; all 27 x 92 = 2,484 fault subgraphs extend to 9-colorings), verified from first principles in < 10 s by pure-stdlib python3 -S verify_bibook_paper.py; (2) Replaced the invalid translation-orbit reduction in Theorem 4 with exact family-automorphism orbit sweeps (BUDGET = 0): <rho> on Q_1(17,4) (27/27 non-spine and 36/36 all orbits UNSAT) and antipodal reflection <iota> on Q_2(13,5) (42/42 orbits UNSAT) and K_8-seeded Q_2(17,4) (252/252 orbits UNSAT); (3) Cited earth_moon_19 v3 [23] in Related Work and Proposition 12(1) for the common-cofacial Euler bound and alpha = 2 17-vertex core; and (4) Corrected the q_1 window at r = 10..16 in Theorem 5 and compressed the abstract and Section 1 contributions.
title: Quarter-Turn Two-Spine Bi-Books in the Earth–Moon Problem: A 17-Vertex Self-Dual Non-Join 9-Critical Core and All-Order Clique-Miss and Port Obstructions
